verdict.rationale: Brex documents AI agents that categorize spend instantly and assistants that write memos and fetch receipts as transactions happen, plus receipt upload with automatic expense matching. It positions this as enabling real-time close, with policy-based documentation requirements, audit and review agents, and automatic expense-data sync to Puzzle accounting. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of merchant and GL/accounting-field coding at transaction time, documented sync to mainstream ERPs beyond Puzzle, and independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing or docs).
